Game Overview

Bomb and Run is a ball game built around dodge, bomb, and dash in "Bomb and Run," the high-octane arcade game testing your reflexes and strategy. Place bombs to obliterate foes, but escape the blast to survive. The stakes rise with every level, offering endless challenges and excitement as you chase ever-higher scores.
